hotel_name: Collection O By Oyo Hotel Evergreen

positive_snippets:
I had a really good experience here. The staff was very co-operative, polite, and helpful.
The rooms and washrooms were clean and well-maintained.
Since it is a newly built hotel, all the furniture was fresh, tidy, and in great condition.
I also found the atmosphere to be safe and comfortable.
The owner, receptionist, and other staff members were equally supportive and welcoming.
Rooms and service was very good…Hotel staff was also very cooperative…It was my second visit..

Exceptional hospitality at Hotel Evergreen! The staff went above and beyond to ensure a comfortable and memorable stay. Impeccable cleanliness, prompt service, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere made it feel like a home away from home. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the Badhkal Lake area.
